title: PI Lunch & Learn: Letters of Protection, Honestly
summary: An honest conversation about LOPs — what providers need to feel secure, what firms can realistically commit to, and where the friction usually starts.
description: Letters of protection are where a lot of attorney-provider relationships quietly go wrong. This session is a candid, no-scripts conversation about what each side actually needs.
A billing manager, a treating provider, and a firm administrator take turns explaining what they see from their chair. The goal is fewer surprises, not a sales pitch.
Lunch is covered. Come with the question you've been too polite to ask.

comments.author: Isaiah Brooks
comments.body: This is the topic I've been waiting for. Would love to see reduction expectations covered — that's where most of my friction is.

comments.author: Camille Fortier
comments.body: Seconding reductions. Also worth covering what happens when a case settles below the lien stack — that conversation is never fun and it's always last-minute.
